sentences.text:
Shri Kamal Singh Baghel, learned Public Prosecutor for the State, in its turn,
opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record so also the fact that the appeal is going to take time for its disposal, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant Pawan Dohar and to release him on bail.
I.A. No.18746/2025 is accordingly allowed with respect to Pawan Dohar.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on 12.05.2026 and such other dates as may be fixed by the trial court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon appellant Pawan Dohar shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
I.A.No.18746/2025 is allowed & disposed of.

List the case for final hearing in Part-B of the cause list as per its turn and seniority.
Certified copy as per rules.
